task: The person repeatedly assembles and takes apart a small orange plastic toy table made of five parts. To assemble it, the parts are picked up from the desk one at a time and fitted together, usually with one hand holding the partial assembly and the other bringing and pressing in a part; to take it apart, the parts are pulled off and put back down on the desk.

objects.name: orange plate
objects.description: the flat orange rectangular plate with a row of three round holes; it is the top of the toy table

objects.name: orange H-shaped piece
objects.description: one of two orange pieces shaped like the letter H; each is a pair of table legs joined by a short bar

objects.name: orange stick
objects.description: one of two long, thin, straight orange sticks; they connect the two H-shaped pieces

objects.name: orange toy table
objects.description: the orange parts when fully or partly fitted together

naming: plain colour + shape names, as a person would say them (v1 used furniture terms: tabletop / leg frame / stretcher)
source: written by Claude from the 16 frames evenly sampled over the take (take_frames/)
